title: Verify identifier format consistency across multiple reports
gherkin:
Given a reporting system with multiple report types
When generating reports for the same entity
Then all identifiers for that entity should use the same format across all reports
rationale: Ensures that identifiers maintain consistent formatting regardless of which report is generated, preventing confusion from different representations of the same entity.
generationSummary: Identifier consistency in reporting ensures that all identifiers used throughout reporting systems remain consistent, accurate, and properly formatted across all reports and data outputs.

title: Verify identifier uniqueness in reporting output
gherkin:
Given a reporting system with multiple data sources
When generating a report that includes data from multiple sources
Then each unique entity should have exactly one identifier representation in the report
rationale: Prevents duplicate or conflicting identifier representations that could lead to data integrity issues or misinterpretation of report contents.
generationSummary: Identifier consistency in reporting ensures that all identifiers used throughout reporting systems remain consistent, accurate, and properly formatted across all reports and data outputs.
